headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Result Update| Sector: Iron & Steel Products SBICAP Securities Limited | 2 Key Highlights of the 2QFY27 Result Robust volume-led growth, partially offset by higher purchases of stock-in trade.

(HITECH) during the quarter reported Revenue/EBITDA/PAT growth of 70.7%/27.6%/34.5% YoY to Rs 1,466 cr/Rs 57 cr/Rs 27 cr, respectively driven by healthy sales volume growth of 31.8% YoY to 1,65,016 MT led by ramp- up of new capacities.
However, EBITDA/t for the quarter stood at ~Rs 3,429, down 3.2% YoY, impacted by higher purchases of stock in trade (Rs 290 cr in 2QFY27 vs Rs 74 cr in 2QFY26).
Further, management has reiterated its target to scale the total capacity to 20,00,000 MTPA by FY29.
valuation: Further, management has reiterated its target to scale the total capacity to 20,00,000 MTPA by FY29.
Maintain BUY- Target Rs 106/- We estimate FY27E/FY28E sales volumes of 6,51,000/7,72,500 MT respectively implying a CAGR of 20.5% over the FY26A-FY28E period.
At the CMP of Rs 78, the stock is currently trading at a P/E multiple of 17.1x/13.3x based on its FY27E/FY28E EPS of Rs 4.6/Rs 5.9 respectively.
